title: Genotyping PCR Protocol
author: Ida Barlow
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7uphnvn
materials: Assemble reagents in master mix tube in following order: 1. Water 2. Primers 3. Taq PCR master mix

Precalculate how many reactions are required for each pair of primers. Remember to include a minus-template control and add 1 to the final number to make sure you don't run out of reagents 1X reaction: 12.5 µL, QIAGEN 2X Taq PCR master mix 2 µL, primer mix 2 µL, genomic DNA 8.5 µL, water 25 µL, TOTAL VOLUME Eg. for 6 reactions, need to prepare (6+1)X reactions

Put the PCR tubes in the thermocycler and run with the geno-PCR program Heat lid: 105 °C Initial denaturation: 00:03:00 93 °C 35 cycles: 1. 00:00:30 93 °C 2. 00:00:30 55 °C, adjust temperature according to primers 3. 00:01:00 72 °C, adjust time according to amplicon size. Rule: 1 min per 1kb Final extension: 00:10:00 72 °C Final Hold: 10 °C

steps.title: Retrieve or prepare primers
steps.instruction: Locate stored primers in the freezer or obtain newly ordered primers.

steps.title: Resuspend new lyophilized primers
steps.instruction: If primers are newly ordered, resuspend each lyophilized oligo to a final concentration of 100 µM (100 μmol L⁻¹). Calculate the volume of molecular‑grade water to add using Volume = nmol × 10; for example, a primer supplied as 28.5 nmol requires 285 µL water.

steps.title: Prepare primer mix from stock
steps.instruction: If using existing stock primers, create a 10 µM primer mix containing both forward and reverse primers. Example: combine 80 µL water, 10 µL of 100 µM forward primer, and 10 µL of 100 µM reverse primer to obtain 100 µL of 10 µM primer mix.

steps.title: Label PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare and label each PCR tube with the appropriate sample identifier.

steps.title: Label master‑mix tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare and label eppendorf tubes that will hold the PCR master mix.

steps.title: Thaw and collect PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Retrieve the PCR master mix and genomic DNA (gDNA) from the freezer. Thaw the PCR master mix on ice, then briefly spin down the tube to collect liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Dispense PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Add 23 µL of the thawed PCR master mix to each labeled PCR tube.

steps.title: Add genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of genomic DNA to each PCR tube containing the master mix.

steps.title: Seal and collect liquid
steps.instruction: Close each tube, ensuring the lid is firmly sealed, then flick the tube to bring all liquid to the bottom.
